description:
One source that did not fully answer during this run (PRD §15 NF4).

The console renders these as a banner and the report repeats them, so
`detail` carries the connector's own words — for the Transparency Center
that is the name of the selector that stopped matching, which is the whole
point of PRD §16's first row.

kind.description: The kind of evidence that came back thin, e.g. `creative`.
kind.title: Kind

nodes.description: Which nodes hit it. Sorted, for a stable banner.
nodes.title: Nodes

detail.description: What the connector said went wrong. Shown verbatim.
detail.title: Detail

severity.description: `degraded` — a connector malfunctioned mid-run and the report is thinner for it. `unavailable` — nothing of this kind is connected, which is a setup state and not a fault.
severity.title: Severity
